upgrades.name: Reset Abilities
upgrades.tooltip: Resets abilities and refunds all ability points (respec).

upgrades.name: Speedboost
upgrades.tooltip: Enables a speedboost ability for harvesters.

upgrades.name: Homebase Magnetizer
upgrades.tooltip: Pulls gems towards the homebase. Closer gems gets pulled faster.

upgrades.name: Magnetizer Strength
upgrades.tooltip: The strength of the homebase's magnet effect on nearby gems.

upgrades.name: Magnetizer Falloff
upgrades.tooltip: Falloff strength.

upgrades.name: Magnetizer Range
upgrades.tooltip: Maximum pull distance

upgrades.name: Magnetizer Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Increase how frequently the Homebase Magnetizer activates.

upgrades.name: Magnetizer Duration
upgrades.tooltip: Duration.

upgrades.name: Basic Harvester Magnet
upgrades.tooltip: Magnetizer also pulls gems toward each basic harvester.

upgrades.name: Magnetizer: Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Magnetizer ability also effects drones.

upgrades.name: Magnetizer: Beacons
upgrades.tooltip: Creates beacons around the homebase which also pulls gems in.

upgrades.name: Beacon Collection
upgrades.tooltip: Allows beacons to also collect the gems it pulls in.

upgrades.name: Chain Magnetizer
upgrades.tooltip: Enables the chain magnetizer ability for the homebase.

upgrades.name: Chain Aftershock
upgrades.tooltip: For each chain there is a chance for a secondary chain to spawn.

upgrades.name: Aftershock Chance
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the chance for each primary chain to trigger an aftershock. Shown as total chance; upgrades add percentage points.

upgrades.name: Chain Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Increase how frequently the Chain Magnetizer activates.

upgrades.name: Chain Count
upgrades.tooltip: Increase number of chains.

upgrades.name: Chain: Basic Harvesters
upgrades.tooltip: Chain Magnetizer also triggers for each basic harvester.

upgrades.name: Chain: Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Chain Magnetizer also triggers for each drone.

upgrades.name: Harvester Chain Count
upgrades.tooltip: Increase number of chains for harvester.

upgrades.name: Ability Slot
upgrades.tooltip: Unlocks an additional ability slot.

upgrades.name: Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Deploys temporary drones to collect gems.

upgrades.name: Drones: Reduce Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Increase how frequently the Drones ability activates.

upgrades.name: Increase Drone Count
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the number of drones.

upgrades.name: Drone Lifetime
upgrades.tooltip: Increase drone lifetime by a percentage of its base duration. Bonuses add together.

upgrades.name: Drone Speed
upgrades.tooltip: Increase drone movement speed by a percentage of base speed. Bonuses add together.

upgrades.name: Basic Harvester Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Deploys a drone from each basic harvester for every required travel distance while the Drones ability is active, at most once every 1 second per harvester.

upgrades.name: Drone Launch Distance
upgrades.tooltip: Reduce the travel distance needed to launch a drone, shown as a percentage reduction from base distance. Launches still have a 1-second cooldown per harvester.

upgrades.name: Drone Recharge
upgrades.tooltip: Collecting gems restores 0.02 seconds of drone lifetime per gem. Total lifespan is limited to twice the upgraded drone lifetime.

upgrades.name: Drone Fission
upgrades.tooltip: On expiry, a drone splits into 2 fresh drones. Offspring cannot split and use the normal lifetime and recharge limits.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawner
upgrades.tooltip: Spawns gems in a circle around the home base.

upgrades.name: Spawner Gem Count
upgrades.tooltip: Increase number of gems spawned.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawner: Cooldown
upgrades.tooltip: Increase how frequently the Gem Spawner ability activates.

upgrades.name: Spawner Ring Count
upgrades.tooltip: Add another ring of gems. Each subsequent ring starts with 50% fewer gems; Ring Reduction upgrades improve its yield.

upgrades.name: Spawner Ring Loss
upgrades.tooltip: Reduce the percentage of gems lost in each subsequent ring by 10 percentage points. At 0% loss, every ring spawns the full gem count.

upgrades.name: Basic Harvester Spawner
upgrades.tooltip: Spawn an extra ring of gems around each basic harvester with 30% of the gem count.

upgrades.name: Gem Spawner: Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Spawn an extra ring of gems around each drone with 10% number of gems.

upgrades.name: Advanced Harvester Magnet
upgrades.tooltip: Magnetizer also pulls gems toward each advanced harvester.

upgrades.name: Expert Harvester Magnet
upgrades.tooltip: Magnetizer also pulls gems toward each expert harvester.

upgrades.name: Ultimate Harvester Magnet
upgrades.tooltip: Magnetizer also pulls gems toward each ultimate harvester.

upgrades.name: Advanced Harvester Chains
upgrades.tooltip: Chain Magnetizer also triggers for each advanced harvester.

upgrades.name: Expert Harvester Chains
upgrades.tooltip: Chain Magnetizer also triggers for each expert harvester.

upgrades.name: Ultimate Harvester Chains
upgrades.tooltip: Chain Magnetizer also triggers for each ultimate harvester.

upgrades.name: Advanced Harvester Spawner
upgrades.tooltip: Spawn an extra ring of gems around each advanced harvester with 30% of the gem count.

upgrades.name: Expert Harvester Spawner
upgrades.tooltip: Spawn an extra ring of gems around each expert harvester with 30% of the gem count.

upgrades.name: Ultimate Harvester Spawner
upgrades.tooltip: Spawn an extra ring of gems around each ultimate harvester with 30% of the gem count.

upgrades.name: Advanced Harvester Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Deploys a drone from each advanced harvester for every required travel distance while the Drones ability is active, at most once every 1 second per harvester.

upgrades.name: Expert Harvester Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Deploys a drone from each expert harvester for every required travel distance while the Drones ability is active, at most once every 1 second per harvester.

upgrades.name: Ultimate Harvester Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Deploys a drone from each ultimate harvester for every required travel distance while the Drones ability is active, at most once every 1 second per harvester.
